Tercihlerin bütünlüğü: The fundamental decision-making principle stating that the consumer can always make a choice by ranking the different product bundles.
Tercihlerin doymazlığı: The fundamental decision-making principle stating that the consumer will always prefer the larger quantity to the smaller.
Tercihlerin geçişliliği: The fundamental decision-making principle stating that the consumer ranks their preferences rationally and consistently.
Tercihlerin sürekliliği: The fundamental decision-making principle stating that there is no jump or interruption among the consumer's preferences.
Ters fiyat ayrımcılığı: Or fourth-degree price discrimination: the practice of selling a certain product to each buyer at the same price even though its cost differs for different buyers.
Ters Repo: Reverse repo transactions are generally carried out, in cases of a temporary liquidity surplus in the market, with the aim of withdrawing the excess liquidity. The central bank sells the instruments in its portfolio to the institutions authorized to conduct open market operations, with a commitment to buy them back at a future date (at the price determined during the transaction). The repurchase price is likewise determined on the date the sale transaction is made. The institution party to the transaction also undertakes to sell the instrument subject to the reverse repo transaction to the central bank at the transaction's maturity. From the central bank's perspective, the reverse repo transaction expresses the temporary withdrawal of liquidity from the market, within the framework of open market operations, for the duration of the transaction's maturity, in return for the instruments given.
Ters seçim: The situation of the party with less information regarding an economic activity making a mistaken choice, with a higher probability than the other party.
Tertip: The banknotes put into circulation with changes made, outside the graphic design and dimensions of the banknotes in circulation, in their authorized signatures, motifs or colors, the printing techniques used, and the security features.
Tevsi Yatırım: The investments directed toward increasing capacity through the addition of a production line or machinery and equipment to an existing investment, and forming a whole by creating common infrastructure with the existing facility. TEYDEB: the abbreviation of the Presidency of Technology and Innovation Support Programs, which administers the incentives and supports offered by the Presidency of the Scientific and Technological Research Council of Türkiye (TÜBİTAK).
Tezgahüstü Piyasalar: The unorganized markets not gathered under a specific structure. The transactions are carried out among the parties through mutual agreement.
Tezgahüstü Türev Piyasalar: The market in which derivative products whose transaction conditions can be flexibly determined by the persons party to the contract are bought and sold. Since the purchase and sale transactions are not carried out on organized platforms like exchanges, it is defined in the over-the-counter market class.
Ticari bono oranı: The interest rate of the short-term private-sector bills with a maturity of at most 270 days.
Ticari serbestleşme: A country's removal of the restrictions on its exports and imports, and its adopting free trade policies.
Toplam arz: Or in short AS: the total quantity of final goods and services that all the units in the economy want to produce and can produce in a given period.
Toplam değişken gider: Or in short TVC: the total of all the variable costs incurred for a certain quantity of product.
Toplam fayda: Or in short TU: the quantity of utility obtained from all the products consumed in a given period.
Toplam gelir: Or in short TR: the revenue obtained in return for selling a certain quantity of product at a certain price.
Toplam gider: Or in short TC: the total of all the costs incurred for a certain quantity of product.
Toplam sabit gider: Or in short TFC: the total of all the fixed costs incurred for a certain quantity of product.
Toplam talep: Or in short AD: the total quantity of final goods and services that all the units in the economy want to purchase and can purchase in a given period.
Toplam talep eğrisi: A graphical tool showing the relationship between the general price level and the total production demanded, all else being constant.
Toplam çıktı: Or total product, in short TP: the quantity of product obtained depending on the quantity of production factors used in a given period.
Toplam ürün: Or total output, in short TP: the quantity of product obtained depending on the quantity of production factors used in a given period.
Toplumsal kayıp ya da dara kaybı: The fall in the economic surplus as a result of more or less of a product being bought and sold in the market than the level ensuring economic efficiency.
Toplumsal refah: Deciding, with limited resources, which products will be produced, how, and for whom, in a way that will benefit the whole of society.
Toprak: Or natural resource, in short N: the fundamental production factor denoting land that can be cultivated or built upon, as well as any kind of resource coming from the land and nature.
Toprak piyasası: The physical or virtual environment where land and natural resources are bought and sold, and in this process the rent rate of land is determined.
Toprak piyasası dengesi: The situation in which, in a given period, the quantity of land demanded in the market equals the quantity of land supplied.
Toprağın kira oranı: Or in short PN: the payment made for using one unit of land or natural resource in production.
Toprağın marjinal ürün geliri: Or in short MRPN: the change seen in total revenue when the quantity of land or natural resources is increased by one unit.
TOSHP Öncelikli Ürün Listesi: The list determined by the Ministry of Industry and Technology, taking into account various criteria such as foreign trade data, demand development and competition intensity, containing the products in the medium-high and high-technology sectors and the products critical for these sectors' development. TSE: the abbreviation of the Turkish Standards Institution, the institution authorized to determine the Turkish standards made compulsory or precautionary by legal regulations within Türkiye, in respect of all kinds of articles and products and of procedures and services.
Transfer ödemesi: The legal payments made by the state without any purchase of a good or service in return.
Treynor oranı: The ratio of the excess return to the systematic risk: (Rp − Rf) / βp. It is the alternative to Sharpe in well-diversified portfolios.
Tutsat (İpotek) Kredileri: Refers to a type of real estate financing system envisaging the extension of long-term housing credits against the mortgage to be realized over real estates such as houses and plots, by a bank or a similar financial institution. In this system, individuals make a certain down payment for the real estate they request, and the remaining amount is covered by the financial institution lending it. The said financial institution has the authority to seize the real estate until the amount it has lent (the credit) is repaid. The repayment of the debt can be realized with fixed or variable interest, following a predetermined payment series. Financial institutions can issue bonds and borrow by showing the mortgage credits they have extended as collateral.
Tutukluların ikilemi: The game theory concept describing the players who cannot cooperate among themselves and act in their own interest ending up, as a result, in the situation that is not the best for them.
Tutumluluk çelişkisi: The view maintaining that, in a closed economy, if more is saved for the purpose of thrift, income will fall, and hence savings will decrease as they try to increase them.
Tüketici dengesi: The situation in which the consumer's total utility is at its maximum, under the budget and product price constraints.
Tüketici Eğilim Anketi: A survey applied monthly with the aim of measuring consumers' current-situation assessments of their personal financial situations and of the general economy, their expectations for the coming period, and their expenditure and saving tendencies in the near future.
Tüketici fazlası: The difference between the highest price the buyer is willing to pay for a product and the product's lower price in the market.
Tüketici Güven Endeksi - TGE: An indicator in which the answers given to the different questions of the Consumer Tendency Survey are evaluated together and summarized, with the aim of following the developments in consumer confidence.
Tüketim fonksiyonu: The mathematical relationship showing how private consumption expenditures change, depending on fundamental variables such as the income level, in an economy.
Tüketimde dışlanabilirlik: Or in short excludability: the possibility of preventing persons who have not purchased a good or service from using that good or service.
Tüketimde rakiplik: The inability of others to use a good or service at the same time as one person uses it.
Türev İşlemler: The transactions in which the maturity, quantity and price of an instrument (currency, interest, commodity) whose delivery will take place on a future date beyond the spot (two business days) transaction date are determined today and bound by contract. Forwards, futures, swaps and options are examples of such transactions.
Türev talep: Or indirect demand: the situation where the demand for an object depends on the demand for the good, service or investment instrument produced or acquired by using that object.
Türev Ürünler: The financial instruments whose return is linked to another instrument's return — in other words, derived from another instrument's return. Futures and option contracts are examples of these instruments. Such instruments can be derived over any kind of product, such as currency, interest and gold. In such a case, for example, in an option contract written on foreign currency, the return of the option contract will depend on the movement in the market of the currency from whose return it was derived.
Uluslararası Yatırım Pozisyonu: The international investment position is the statistic showing, at a certain date, the stock value of the financial receivables of the resident persons in an economy from non-resident persons, of their financial assets in the form of gold held as reserve assets, and of the residents' financial liabilities to non-resident persons.
Undertaking (Enterprise): The units that are real and legal persons producing, marketing and selling goods or services in the market, that can take decisions independently, and that constitute an economic whole. (See Competition Act, Art. 3) Since the principle of economic unity is adopted in the said definition, a subsidiary is evaluated not on its own, but together with the other company or companies to which it is affiliated.
Undertakings: Refers to the decisions taken by the undertaking associations. According to Article 4 of the Competition Act, the decisions and actions of the undertaking associations carrying the aim of preventing, distorting or restricting competition directly or indirectly in a certain market for goods or services, or producing or being capable of producing this effect, are unlawful and prohibited.
Unique Transaction Reference: Number: the unique transaction reference number, expressing the combination of letters, numbers and symbols determined by the payment service provider, in conformity with the payment and settlement or messaging system protocols used for electronic transfer. UN Convention against Corruption: the UN Convention against Corruption, adopted by the UN General Assembly on 31 October 2003.
